name: glacia-monorepo
description: Monorepo for Glacia: Apple's Liquid Glass UI kit for React and React Native

scripts.build: pnpm --filter glacia-tokens build && pnpm --filter glacia build && pnpm --filter glacia-native build && pnpm registry:build && pnpm --filter docs build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter glacia test && pnpm --filter glacia-native test
scripts.packages:publish: pnpm --filter glacia-tokens publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter glacia publish --access public --no-git-checks && pnpm --filter glacia-native publish --access public --no-git-checks
